exposure: Medicaid reimbursement program for immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (LARC)
cohort: The study included 6,233 eligible patients who delivered at a large, urban, tertiary medical center one year before and one year after a change in Missouri Medicaid coverage, excluding those who delivered prior to 24 weeks gestation or had a contraindication to immediate postpartum LARC.
finding: The change in Missouri Medicaid reimbursement for immediate postpartum LARC significantly increased LARC uptake from 0.7% pre-policy to 9.7% post-policy, impacting all patients regardless of insurance provider.
